name: rpg-story-life
description: MMORPG de texto em tempo real - Inspirado em AQWorlds, DragonFable, Adventure Quest

scripts.build: cd backend && npm ci && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.start: cd backend && if (Test-Path node_modules) { node dist/server.js } else { npm ci && npx prisma generate && npm run build && node dist/server.js }
scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
